connector.name: ClariLayer
connector.registryDescription: Individual-analyst context layer: recall, remember, and reconcile your data and engineering context.
connector.summary: Hosted at clarilayer.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the clarilayer account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer cl_<your ClariLayer context key> — mint one at clarilayer.com via Connect your AI
